changelog:
- Initial release of Product Prompt Generator.
- Generates high-quality English prompts for AI product image generation based on detailed product info.
- Supports multiple product categories, including electronics, apparel, beauty, home goods, and more.
- Ensures prompts are concise (≤500 characters), accurate, and focused on a single product subject.
- Allows for style customization and uses keyword optimization for better discoverability.
summary: Generate high-quality product image prompts for AI image generation tools based on user-provided product information.
